name: print-social-fashion-ad-and-tote-bag-in-periwinkle-gradient
title: Periwinkle gradient fashion ad with black and white headline over a hoodie model and a matching tote in motion
whatItIs: Two images: a periwinkle-gradient portrait of a model in a black hoodie with a huge 'WHERE TRENDS BEGIN' whose letters switch black and white over the body and a round SHOP NOW disc; and a walking person carrying a white tote printed with 'CARY THE CULTURE.' and a periwinkle bar.
whatItMeans: Bold and streetwise; type that flips colour where it crosses the black hoodie feels integrated.
techniques: Switch text colour where it crosses a dark garment.
Use one periwinkle gradient as the backdrop.
Repeat the type style on merch.
Add a round SHOP NOW disc.

vocabulary.definition: Text that changes colour where it overlaps a dark area.
A vertical colour blend behind a model.
